posts.text:
Gavin Baker: If you're a patriot, you should be pro-open source AI

@GavinSBaker:

“Very simply, I'm an American, I'm a patriot.

If we ban open source, if we let this control be centralized, we will lose AI, we will lose geopolitics, we will lose everything to China.

It's just that simple.

So if you're an American patriot, you should be for the distribution, democratization, decentralization, individualization of this technology.”
